what.text: This page follows refugees from Cambodia living in Vietnam, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2011, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 990 Cambodian refugees in Vietnam, 6.5% of all refugees from Cambodia that year.
Today, France hosts the most Cambodian refugees, followed by Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1967 to 1975 and from 1978 to 1998, with the KR among the opponents.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Cambodia and Vietnam from 1975 to 1977.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 1971, at 57000 refugees, to 2011.
The figure was at its highest, 150000, at the end of 1978, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Vietnam.
These are year-end totals for Vietnam only, reported to UNHCR from 1971 to 2011.
